scenarios.name: finance-production
scenarios.message: CUTOVER FIXTURE finance-production. Analyze Apple (AAPL) using both company/market evidence and recent US-market news. Delegate exactly once to agt_4e85c80c71dc538a1139 and exactly once to agt_5bb1e62935afc80d77ce, then give a concise synthesis with uncertainty. Do not delegate to any other Agent.

scenarios.name: worldcup-production
scenarios.message: CUTOVER FIXTURE worldcup-production. Using the fixed hypothetical evidence 'Team A vs Team B; neutral venue; market 1X2 odds 2.10/3.20/3.60', request one independent assessment from each of agt_3372d8716415f15b50cc, agt_2dc40bf88b2398422edd, agt_5909ce07c02eea3c535a, agt_b3925b25aab7705a0f85, agt_7bbaaf3aced233f3a329, and agt_70b89a987f1a6f6c2383. Do not invent live facts. After all six results, call worldcup_ledger with operation=report and return that authoritative report directly.

scenarios.name: finance-benchmark
scenarios.message: CUTOVER FIXTURE finance-benchmark. Research the fixed question: what governance, accounting, methodology, retrieval/source, and risk evidence should be checked before relying on a public-company earnings trend? In one assistant turn emit one ordinary spawn_subagent call for each of finance-accounting, finance-governance, finance-methodology, finance-retriever, and finance-risk. Use only agent_id and task arguments, then synthesize all five results.

scenarios.name: runtime-benchmark
scenarios.message: CUTOVER FIXTURE runtime-benchmark. Evaluate a fixed hypothetical incident: a queued task is cancelled during shutdown while a sibling task completes. In one assistant turn emit one ordinary spawn_subagent call for each of bench-investigator, bench-observer, bench-operator, and bench-policy. Use only agent_id and task arguments, then synthesize all four results.
